NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: MUP-2017-20 Location: 401 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8608-029-022
Applicant: Jeremy Thana
The project is proposing extended hours of operation from 7:00 a.m. – 2:00 a.m. at an existing café. The property is located in the Route 66 District of the Azusa TOD Specific Plan.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 1 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301), (California Environmental Quality Act).

2.
Case No.: DR-2018-18, UP-2018-05, V-2018-01 Location: 295 S. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8614-014-054
Applicant: Nathan Toobian
The project is proposing an exterior façade improvement and intensification of the use by expanding the retail use of the existing building. The project is also proposing a Use Permit for a service station use since the existing service station use is nonconforming. A Variance is being proposed for a nonconforming lot size for the proposed service station use. The property is located in the CSA (South Azusa Corridor) zone.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 1 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301), (California Environmental Quality Act).
